name: tabgattai
description: Save and restore tabs with latest-wins duplicate URL merging (Chrome extension, Manifest V3).

scripts.e2e: vite build --mode e2e --outDir dist-e2e && node e2e/run.mjs dist-e2e
scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f tabgattai-$npm_package_version.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../tabgattai-$npm_package_version.zip . && cd .. && echo Created tabgattai-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.store-images: vite build --mode e2e --outDir dist-e2e && node store/generate.mjs dist-e2e
